title: Illegal Dumping Sign
description: Use this service request to apply for a sign to prohibit illegal dumping of trash, garbage and solid waste. The estimated response time for this service request is 10 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is there a need for a sign at this location?
Has there been a sign at this location before?
Where do you want the sign to be placed?

options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed
observedQuestions.prompt: Would you like to be contacted?

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to apply for a sign prohibiting illegal dumping of trash, garbage, or solid waste at a specified location.
actions.why: To apply for a sign prohibiting illegal dumping of trash, garbage, or solid waste at a specified location. The request form asks whether a sign is needed there, whether one was there before, and where it should be placed.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Illegal Dumping Sign"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Illegal Dumping Sign"
